record.paper: Induced 2-degenerate Subgraphs of Triangle-free Planar Graphs

dossier_meta.paper: Induced 2-degenerate Subgraphs of Triangle-free Planar Graphs
dossier_meta.statement_text: Every triangle-free planar graph contains an induced 2-degenerate subgraph on at least $\frac{7}{8}$ of its vertices.
dossier_meta.context_text: The authors introduce this as the central open problem motivating the paper, noting it would be tight for the cube (the unique 3-regular triangle-free planar graph on 8 vertices). The paper's main theorems (Theorems 1.2 and 1.3) prove weaker bounds of $\frac{4}{5}$ and $\frac{7}{8}n - 18n_3$ respectively as partial progress.
